description: This file provides implementations related to autograd input metadata, including functions and methods for handling tensor shapes, nested tensors, shape compatibility, and gradient reduction within the PyTorch framework.

classes.name: InputMetadata
classes.description: Class encapsulating metadata about tensor inputs, including shape, options, nestedness, and methods for shape compatibility and gradient operations.
